text:
Alex C: Hey @people-ops — quick/quiet question. I’ve been dealing with post-viral fatigue and mornings are brutal. Can we talk about temporarily shifting my recurring 9am design critiques to later in the day and taking one sync off my calendar for 6 weeks? I don’t want to make a big thing of it publicly.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks for flagging this, Alex. We can definitely cover the critique for a bit. I can take the standing slot two days a week and rotate coverage. Do you want me to propose a calendar change or should People Ops handle the formal accommodation? :slightly_smiling_face:
Alex C: Appreciate it Jordan. If People Ops needs anything formal I can do that, but want to avoid email threads with the whole org. Prefer private handling.
Sasha (People Ops): Hi Alex — Sasha from People Ops. Thanks for reaching out and sorry you’re dealing with that. We can absolutely handle this confidentially. Two quick options: 1) temporary informal manager agreement (no docs) or 2) short-term ADA accommodation with an intake form (keeps records and gives schedule protections). Which do you prefer?
Alex C: Prefer the intake form so there’s a record, but I don’t have a formal note yet. Is a doctor’s note required?
Sasha (People Ops): Not always. For short-term adjustments we can often proceed with the intake form + manager agreement and optional medical documentation later if needed. If you want privacy we can redact notes in the file and limit access to People Ops + your manager.
Jordan (Eng Manager): I’ll sign off on whatever Alex needs. I can also assign a rotating note-taker for critiques so Alex can skip without pressure.
Alex C: That would help — thanks. Can you also mark the calendar change as private? Don’t want to broadcast this org-wide.
Sasha (People Ops): Yep. I’ll create the intake ticket and DM you the link. PeopleOpsBot: HR request 1767890 submitted for Alex C — status: intake_started.
Alex C: Got the link, filling it out now. Thank you.
Sasha (People Ops): After you submit I’ll follow up with a short confirmation email and a private calendar update proposal for Jordan to approve. If anything changes you can always switch back. :pray:
Jordan (Eng Manager): Cool — I’ll block time on my calendar to cover Fridays. LMK if you want me to loop someone else in as backup.
Alex C: That works. Appreciate the quick help and discretion.
Sasha (People Ops): Closing the thread here once intake is complete. Ping me if you need immediate time off or extra handoffs this week.
PeopleOpsBot: Intake form completed by Alex C at 1767891540 — next step: manager sign-off.
